name: coroflot-mcp
description: Coroflot (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Coroflot's all-jobs RSS 2.0 feed (FeedBurner, latest 30 design jobs). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<Company> is seeking a <Role>'; the item description is only the job location, so it is mapped to location. id is the posting link.
